svg.title: ULTRA-SATISFACTORY: an 8-bit demo screen drawn in the attribute grid
svg.desc: An 8-bit home computer demo screen: 32 by 24 colour cells, two colours per cell, inside a black border with three raster bars drifting through it. A chunky two-armed spiral of black, blue, magenta and red cells turns behind ULTRA, built from whole bright-cyan cells, above SATISFACTORY in white and a yellow bar reading: a companion app for Satisfactory. Three block-highlighted tabs take turns lighting up: OBJECTIVES (5 Space Elevator shopping lists), ITEMS (140 items, 211 recipes, 1 search) and BUILDINGS (477 buildings and what they make). Below them a twister effect turns out to be one giant rotating screw, driven by a machine with a hexagon-and-cog emblem and emptying into a crate labelled SCREWS, captioned with the real recipe: Screw 40 per minute, Constructor, 6 seconds, 4 MW. A rainbow-banded scroller runs along the bottom; its colours stay locked to the cells while the text moves. Unofficial fan project.
